## About
Atlas Auto Body & Paint is a full-service collision repair shop in Richardson, serving drivers across the Metroplex. Our management team is the second generation in the collision repair industry, and referrals are our main source of new customers.
We work on domestic and import cars, from body work and paint to frame straightening, suspension, air conditioning and auto glass. We stand behind all our repair work with a lifetime warranty.
Customers rate us 4.6 on Google from 48 reviews. One reviewer wrote that David and Reza really care for their customers. You'll find us at the same location on S Central Expy, with our office now in the left corner unit.

## Services
- Collision repair and painting: Body and paint repair after an accident, for domestic and import cars.
- Color matching: We match the color so the repair blends in with the rest of the car.
- Frame straightening: Getting your car's frame back where it belongs after a collision.
- Hail damage repair: We repair hail damage.
- Paintless dent removal: Paintless dent removal, also known as PDR.
- Suspension repair: Suspension work to get your car riding right again.
- Auto glass: Glass work as part of getting your car back on the road.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies, and you can call us with any questions about insurance claims.

Q: Do you work on imports?
A: Yes. We work on both domestic and import cars.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8 to 6. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Did you move?
A: No, we're at the same location. We just moved our office to the left corner, Number 128.
